sloka: ततो ऽहं विपुलं रूपं संक्षिप्य निमिषान्तरात् ।तस्या हृदयमादाय प्रपतामि नभःस्थलम् ।। ५.५८.४२ ।।।।
transliteration: tato 'haṁ vipulaṁ rūpaṁ saṁkṣipya nimiṣāntarāt ।tasyā hṛdayamādāya prapatāmi nabhaḥsthalam ।। 5.58.42 ।।।।

translations.english: "In a moment I reduced from a huge form to a small one, entered her heart and sprang into the sky.
